g.text: AA05 - Customer Ownership Verification and Confidentiality
This flow starts after authentication and the operation's role check succeed.
Authentication and role-denial responses are shown in the role-authorization SD.
request customer-data operation with resource ID
[ownership check is not required (unscoped operation or explicit exemption)]
[Customer does not own the requested resource, or no linked Customer exists]
A multi-role user such as EMPLOYEE + CUSTOMER can use operations
allowed to either role, but the additional role does not bypass
ownership checks on customer data. An exemption applies only when
explicitly defined for the specific operation.
